evidence.claim: The project is named 'parcel-pipeline' and uses Rust edition 2024.
The project version is set to 0.1.0.
The project is configured as a workspace.
The library operates as a synthetic synchronous dispatch mechanism rather than a running service.
The system utilizes bounded unique pending IDs to manage dispatch tasks.
Dispatch execution halts immediately upon encountering a failure.
The configuration accepts an optional decimal capacity parameter.
The function returns an Ok result with a default value of 2 when the input is None.
The flush function iterates through the queue front, attempting to send each item via the provided callback.
The library exports four distinct modules: config, delivery, queue, and report.
Queue construction fails if capacity is zero.
Queue construction succeeds and initializes an empty pending queue.
Submitting an ID that already exists in the pending queue returns false without error.
Submitting an ID when the pending queue is full returns an error.
The Report struct exposes three public fields: sent (usize), failed (bool), and remaining (usize).
The capacity function returns an error when the input string is empty, zero, exceeds 16, or contains non-numeric characters or leading whitespace.
